catalog.name: codewhale
catalog.description: First-party Codewhale extensions: the plugins and skills Codewhale ships, maintained in the open so anyone can propose a change.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: See the screen and operate it: accessibility-first control, screenshots and zoom on macOS, Windows and Linux, plus macOS recording and HarmonyOS devices over hdc.

plugins.name: whalewiki
plugins.description: An evidence-bound wiki for the repo: generated pages sealed against the source files they were written from, computed staleness, a zero-install CI drift gate, and a read-only MCP surface.

plugins.name: cloudflare-docs
plugins.description: Cloudflare's official remote docs MCP: current Workers/Pages/storage/platform documentation search. No credentials required.

plugins.name: codewhale-skills
plugins.description: The Codewhale skill set as one reviewed plugin: implement, debug, test, review, verify, webapp-testing, release, handoff, research and the rest of the bundled workflow skills. Each arrives namespaced as codewhale-skills:<name>. These skills also ship inside the Codewhale binary; install this bundle to carry a reviewed copy to a host that only loads plugins.
